name: Martial Glacier: Mirador de los Cóndores
why: From the edge of town to the moraine under the Martial Glacier in about an hour and a half, with the Beagle Channel below you all the way.
book: Free path ('Circuito de las Nubes' of the Cerro Martial park). Taxi or minivan from Ushuaia to the Refugio Base at the end of the Martial road; a return taxi for two costs less than the minivan.
water: Meltwater streams; the teahouse at the start.
dangers: Loose scree on the moraine: don't walk onto the ice.
Weather turns fast: a warm layer and a shell even in January.
turnaround: In wind or rain, stop at the lower glacier lookout (Mirador del Glaciar) above the old chairlift.

points.name: Refugio Base, Cerro Martial
points.note: The end of the Martial road, about 7 km above the town centre, with the teahouse. Take the Sendero de los Pioneros.

points.name: Lookout over Ushuaia and the Beagle Channel
points.note: Where the old chairlift ended: the whole bay of Ushuaia and the Chilean islands across the channel.

points.name: Mirador de los Cóndores, Martial Glacier
points.note: At 850 m on top of the frontal moraine: the glacier's ice and cirque right above you.
